create_k_fold_train_valid_split: create a k-fold cross validation train and valid split from chunked annotated data directories
generate_recombined_data_from_templates_: generate recombined chat and tree data by swapping fragments between templates and fragments
process_chat_with_span_replacement: process a chat string by removing a token span and inserting an unknown token placeholder

write_recombined_data_chunk: write recombined data samples to an output directory as JSON from tool1 and tool2 Turk data
